limitations: One serialized desktop capture per project/version/motion, with profiling/automation overhead; event p95 is a sample percentile, not field INP.
Deep drills take the same actual category/file paths; asynchronous arrivals/visible declaration counts and map-read counts can still differ. Total phase duration includes deliberate waits.
Initial-load samples expose remaining startup cost; a layout cache is not a blanket first-open speedup. The first prototype was slower and prompted prefix/allocation cleanup.
Reference resolution in the complete EthLib map, main-thread validation/materialization and remaining React reconciliation are still open.
Native Lake dependency/query work and exact complete input verification remain unchanged; nested spans overlap and host thread CPU excludes child processes.
